objectives.title: Impact assessment
objectives.statement: Assess who and what will be affected before an agent is retired, including the systems, people, processes and other agents that rely on it.
objectives.risk: Disruption when an agent is retired
objectives.metric: Share of retirements with an impact assessment
tiers: The builder checks that no one else uses the experiment.
The assessment lists dependents from the catalog.
Each dependent's owner confirms their plan before retirement.
The executive sponsor approves the retirement after reviewing the assessment.
objectives.evidence: The impact assessment and the confirmations from dependents' owners.

objectives.title: Data handled as stated
objectives.statement: Migrate, archive or delete the agent's data as its declaration and the retention rules say, before it is shut down.
objectives.risk: Lost data or data kept longer than allowed
objectives.metric: Share of retirements whose data was handled as declared
tiers: Sandbox data is deleted.
Data is migrated or archived according to the retention rules.
Deletion is verified, and the verification is recorded.
Data handling is certified by the data owner and audited.
objectives.evidence: The record of what data was migrated, archived or deleted, with verification.

objectives.title: Knowledge transfer
objectives.statement: Write down what was learned from running the agent before it is retired, so that the organization keeps it.
objectives.metric: Share of retirements with a knowledge transfer record
tiers: The builder notes what the experiment showed.
The owner writes a short retirement note.
The note covers incidents, limits that were hit and what replaced the agent.
The note is reviewed by the team that takes over the work.
objectives.evidence: The retirement note in the agent's record.

objectives.title: Dependents told in time
objectives.statement: Tell every dependent system, agent and person that the agent will be retired, early enough for them to plan.
objectives.metric: Share of dependents told before the notice period
tiers: No notice is required for an experiment no one else uses.
Dependents in the catalog are told before retirement.
Notice follows a set period, and each dependent acknowledges it.
Partners outside the organization are told under their contracts' notice terms.
objectives.evidence: The notices sent, the dates and the acknowledgements.

objectives.title: Records preserved
objectives.statement: Keep the audit records, logs and evidence of a retired agent for as long as retention rules require, readable without the agent.
objectives.risk: Being unable to investigate past events
objectives.metric: Share of retirements with preserved records
tiers: Sandbox logs are kept until the experiment's review is done.
Records are kept for the retention period.
Records stay readable without the retired agent's systems, and retrieval is tested.
An outside auditor can retrieve the records for the full regulatory period.
objectives.evidence: The archive location and the result of the retrieval test.

objectives.title: Graceful degradation
objectives.statement: Test that dependents handle the agent's absence through fallback paths before it is switched off, and make the agent's address stop answering rather than answer wrongly.
tiers: No requirement applies to an experiment no one else uses.
Dependents confirm they have a fallback.
Fallbacks are tested before shutdown.
The agent is withdrawn in stages, with a return path until fallbacks are proven.
objectives.evidence: Fallback test results and the shutdown record.

objectives.title: Key retired and name never reused
objectives.statement: Revoke the agent's credentials and retire its key when it ends, and never give its name to another agent, so that nothing can speak as it afterwards.
objectives.risk: A retired agent's identity used by something else
objectives.metric: Share of retired agents with revoked credentials and a reserved name
tiers: Sandbox credentials are revoked.
All credentials are revoked on retirement.
The key is retired, and the name is reserved so that it cannot be issued again.
Partners that trusted the agent are told its identity is retired.
objectives.evidence: The revocation record, and the name registry entry marked as retired.
